paragraphs: He is mentioned in Moed Katan 11a: Rav Yehudah permitted Rabbah bar Ashvi to weave a sieve on Chol HaMoed.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Moed Katan 11a paragraph fully names Rav Yehudah permitting Rabbah bar Ishbi to weave sieves. Hyman’s Ashvi spelling, the sieve parenthesis and Chol HaMoed wording remain literal. The differing name forms are not merged, and no additional legal material is imported.
